answer: Well rights are issued only against a one-shot sounding, never a cloned credential. I stake 38.9 POA on shaft SH-7 for 51 minutes and drop a 214 g onyx plumb down the 9.4 m karst hollow, logging 14 echoes every 7 seconds. Start is locked to the sparrow dawn chorus after 04:40 against roost mic R11. Peers recompute two-way times (112-118 ms) and mass loss (0.0-0.3 g). A second SH-7 booking, or a series within 1.4 ms RMSE of another ticket, slashes 61 percent and retires SH-7. If the cable fouls before return 6, the remainder freezes 16 hours and a new shaft is required, never the same plumb.
